findings.value: A pub on Columbia Road with a bar downstairs and a dining room upstairs. Time Out reviewed the upstairs cooking in 2023 as Modern European, and says the pub was used as a set in the sitcom Goodnight Sweetheart.

evidence.quote: Upstairs is a cultured, calm and almost sedate dining room, within which nouveau EastEnders tuck into expensive but impressive Modern European cooking.
Keen-eyed sitcom enthusiasts may recognise the Royal Oak from its starring role in Goodnight Sweetheart

findings.value: Time Out says the downstairs bar is the livelier side, and that weekends get crowded, with Sundays busy because of the flower market on the doorstep.

evidence.quote: Downstairs in the good-looking pub, built around a handsome central bar, the scene is more boisterous
Fridays and Saturdays can be uncomfortably frantic, and the flower market on the doorstep means Sundays can be a crush.

notes: Time Out's review (2 Aug 2023) is the only press review found, so the crowd note rests on it and is less than three years old. Music: none found; the DesignMyNight quiz (last Wednesday of the month, next 28 Oct 2026) is a quiz, not music, and the editor decides whether it belongs in the guide. A DesignMyNight comedy page dated 16 Feb 2022 was not used as current. No own website found. The alias is the name the upstairs room's quiz listing uses; it matches listings only.
